summary: babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, then invokes it to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `@bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with a rotating string-array decoder (functions `WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`), `_0xNNNN`-style identifiers, and thousands of encoded string constants. The file is not referenced from `lib/index.js` and has no relationship to the package's stated purpose (a small Babel plugin that rewrites `@linaria/*` tagged templates to `undefined`). Installing the package causes an alternate language runtime to be fetched and used to execute opaque, install-time-only code that Node-focused tooling cannot inspect. The package appears to be a hijacked or typosquat variant of ornikar/babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
